Title: Lenovo XClarity Integrator for Azure Log Analytics

Body.Content:
Today we're announcing Lenovo XClarity Integrator for Azure Log Analytics.

The Lenovo XClarity Integrator solution lets you analyze events from the Lenovo XClarity Administrator product and the resources that are managed by Lenovo XClarity Administrator. These insights can help systems administrators find potential problems in their environment.

Check out the Lenova XClarity Administrator documentation to learn more about steps to enable the solution and the capabilities.

Note that you should also configure data collection to be able to view the dashboards in your Log Analytics workspace. For details on data collection, see the Lenovo XClarity Administrator Log Forwarder documentation.
